# Shared task manager

## Objective

Build a shared task manager for assigning work with deadlines.

## Product decisions

- **D1 — Team scope (Assumption):** Use one shared workspace.

## Visible success

- A member can create and assign a task.

## Expected refusals

- A task cannot be assigned to an unknown member.

## Assumptions

- One server instance hosts the workspace.

## Non-goals

- Billing and attachments.

## Open decisions

None.
